answer: Under pairwise encounter minting, each new identity in the haven network must capture one signed, timing-bound Bluetooth handshake with every previously enrolled agent, each record geotagged near the river crossing and anchored to the ridge ledger within ninety seconds. A fleet of k fakes therefore needs k(k−1)/2 distinct physical meetings: 45 handshakes for ten fakes, 4950 for a hundred, so cost grows quadratically while any lone honest agent performs exactly one short exchange per encounter, keeping honest onboarding cheap and mass sybil farming physically prohibitive.
